lines: Rukh se parda utha de zara, saaqiya
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face a little, cupbearer.

lines: Bas abhi rang-e-mehfil badal jaaega
couplets.en: The gathering will take on a different hue in an instant.

lines: Rukh se parda utha de zara, saaqiya
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face a little, cupbearer.

lines: Bas abhi rang-e-mehfil badal jaaega
couplets.en: The gathering will take on a different hue in an instant.

lines: Hai jo behosh, vo hosh mein aaega
couplets.en: The one who has fainted will come round.

lines: Girne vaala hai jo, vo sambhal jaaega
couplets.en: The one about to fall will find his footing.

lines: Rukh se parda utha de
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face.

lines: Tum tasalli na do, sirf baithe raho
couplets.en: Spare me words of comfort and just sit beside me.

lines: Vaqt kuchh mere marne ka tal jaaega
couplets.en: My death will wait a little longer.

lines: Kya ye kam hai, Masiha, ki rehne hi se
couplets.en: Is it a small thing, healer, that your presence alone could do this?

lines: Maut ka bhi iraada badal jaaega
couplets.en: Even death will change its mind.

lines: Rukh se parda utha de
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face.

lines: Teer ki jaan hai dil, dil ki jaan teer hai
couplets.en: The heart is the arrow's life, and the arrow is the heart's.

lines: Teer ko na yoon kheencho, kaha maan lo
couplets.en: Do as I ask and leave the arrow where it is.

lines: Teer ki jaan hai dil, dil ki jaan teer hai
couplets.en: The heart is the arrow's life, and the arrow is the heart's.

lines: Teer ko na yoon kheencho, kaha maan lo
couplets.en: Do as I ask and leave the arrow where it is.

lines: Teer kheencha to dil bhi nikal aaega
couplets.en: Draw the arrow out and the heart will come with it.

lines: Dil jo nikla to dam bhi nikal jaaega
couplets.en: When the heart goes, the breath goes with it.

lines: Rukh se parda utha de
couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face.

lines: Is ke hansne mein rone ka andaaz hai
couplets.en: There is something of weeping in his laughter.

lines: Khaak udaane mein fariyaad ka raaz hai
couplets.en: There is a hidden plea in the dust he scatters.

lines: Is ko chhedo na, Anwar, Khuda ke liye
couplets.en: For God's sake, Anwar, leave him be.

lines: Varna beemaar ka dam nikal jaaega
couplets.en: Or the poor man will breathe his last.

couplets.en: Lift the veil from your face a little, cupbearer.
